payload.text: **Resolve a path before calling it a duplicate.** On rhadamanth ~/bin is a symlink to .local/bin, so two PATH entries named one directory, and the 'stray' ~/.local/bin/molt was hv's only molt link; vc removed it on 24 Oct and briefly left hv with no molt. Compare inodes (stat -f %i) or resolved dirs before removing, and treat a doctor shadow check the same way: compare resolved directories, never path strings.
